sources.title: Ling-3.0-tiny-fp8 · Models
sources.snippet: We are introducing Ling-3.0-tiny, a lightweight hybrid reasoning MoE model with 7.9B total parameters and only 1.3B activated parameters per token. It is designed to deliver strong reasoning and agentic capabilities at low inference cost, making advanced model capabilities more accessible for local and resource-constrained deployment.

sources.title: Ling 3.0 Tiny (Free) API | Vercel AI Gateway
sources.snippet: Ling-3.0-tiny is an efficient 7.9B-parameter MoE model with only 1.3B active parameters per token. It is designed for responsive AI agents, reliable instruction following, and natural multi-turn conversations. The model features a 256K context window, native function calling, prompt caching, and switchable Thinking and Instant modes.
